description: Source code for the Android graphics transaction completion listener interface, including class definitions, parcelable serialization, and IPC handling.

classes.name: FrameEventHistoryStats
classes.description: Holds statistics about frame rendering times and fences, with parcelable serialization.

classes.name: JankData
classes.description: Represents jank (performance hiccup) data associated with frames.

classes.name: SurfaceStats
classes.description: Contains surface-related timing and fence information, parcelable.

classes.name: TransactionStats
classes.description: Aggregates callback IDs, timing, fences, and surface stats for a transaction.

classes.name: ListenerStats
classes.description: Holds callback and transaction stats for a listener, with factory method.

classes.name: BpTransactionCompletedListener
classes.description: Proxy class for sending transaction completion IPC calls.

classes.name: BnTransactionCompletedListener
classes.description: Binder class handling incoming transaction completion IPC calls.

classes.name: CallbackId
classes.description: Identifies callback types, supports parcelable serialization.

classes.name: ReleaseCallbackId
classes.description: Identifier for release buffer callbacks, parcelable.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes object data into a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes object data from a Parcel.

methods.name: createEmpty
methods.description: Creates an empty ListenerStats with specified listener and callback IDs.
